sections.title: Muscle Basics
points: Definition: Muscles are elastic bundles of flesh or fibers that produce movement.
Attachment: They connect to bones using tough fibrous tissues called Tendons.
The Pull Rule: Muscles can ONLY PULL bones; they can never push.

sections.title: Cardiac Muscle (The Specialist)
points: Found ONLY in the walls of the heart.
It combines the strength of skeletal muscle with the automatic nature of smooth muscle.
It contracts rhythmically throughout life and never gets tired.
It only stops working when the person is dead.

sections.text: Skeletal muscles are often called Striped or Striated muscles because of their appearance under a microscope. Smooth muscles are found in the alimentary canal to push food via peristalsis.

cards.fact: The unique muscle found only in the heart.
Muscles that move without you thinking about it.
